messages.subject: Quartz - internal note before report on title
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Before I finalise the report on title, the open points are: (1) outstanding Meridian rent review - recommend we take conduct post-completion; (2) Carrington £6,800 service-charge query - propose a retention on the completion statement; (3) Pennine Business Bank charge - need an undertaking to discharge from Marlowe Greaves. Title is otherwise clean (absolute, four leases, WAULT ~4.9 yrs).

Draft ROT to client by tomorrow. Agreed?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
